purpose: Programs the pre-W1b legality machinery (provider-file walk, known_file gates, per-target available maps) rejected and genuine Bazel 9.3 accepts: a File reachable only through a closure as an input and as a declare_file sibling, provider payloads with range/200-deep/cyclic/bound-method values, a workspace status file in DefaultInfo without an action; plus regression rows (three-hop provider file, forwarded DefaultInfo, generated tool runfile), the declared-output conflict (both fail, texts differ) and the analysis-bound payloads Bazel keeps and the native profile rejects explicitly. W1 review F1 rows (status_*): a workspace status file reached only through an executable's own runfiles, a dependency's runfiles merged by an executable, a library's runfiles (built with it), an output group or a top-level aspect's output group, each target alone under build and --nobuild; before F1 the native profile resolved it only when another target of the build had registered the status files. runfiles_manifest_input*: a tool's files_to_run.runfiles_manifest as an action input (the planned manifest node's File; None under --nobuild_runfile_manifests in both). integration-20 rows status_files_of_a_dependency*: a dependency (//pkg:status_files) returns its ctx.info_file and ctx.version_file in DefaultInfo; //pkg:status_report reaches them through ctx.files, dep[DefaultInfo].files and Target.files, directly and through a filegroup forwarding the dependency, and describes each (path, short_path, is_source, root, owner, equality with its own ctx.info_file/ctx.version_file, membership in a depset of its own) under build and --nobuild: one File each, short_path stable-status.txt/volatile-status.txt, a derived File of the bazel-out root. Before the fix the dependency's view handed out short_path bazel-out/stable-status.txt, root '', is_source True under --nobuild, unequal (set_size=4); the pre-W1b base rejects the program (DefaultInfo file has no artifact). Schema v3 adds `report` (the print lines) to these rows' runs and the EXACT_REPORT verdict.
